spec_version: SAGE-X v1r0 + ISL r2 bridge draft
description: Granular local-first implementation task graph for moving from SAGE-X and ISL specifications to a minimal implementation foundation.

steps.name: Create repository/module skeleton
steps.description: Create the initial local-first module layout and preserve logical service boundaries.

steps.name: Implement platform schema loader
steps.description: Load and parse the consolidated SAGE-X platform schema.

steps.name: Index schema definitions by artifact type
steps.description: Create a definition index for named schema artifacts.

steps.name: Implement validator wrapper
steps.description: Validate arbitrary artifacts against a named schema definition.

steps.name: Create fixture scaffold
steps.description: Create fixture directories and naming convention.

steps.name: Create artifact manifest fixture
steps.description: Create the first artifact manifest fixture.

steps.name: Create contract test harness
steps.description: Run schema validation tests for fixtures.

steps.name: Create ISL plugin registration fixture
steps.description: Define the first ISL plugin registration artifact.

steps.name: Implement plugin registry
steps.description: Register and look up specification plugins.

steps.name: Create valid specification ingestion fixture
steps.description: Create a minimal valid ISL-like ingestion request.

steps.name: Create invalid specification ingestion fixture
steps.description: Create an invalid ingestion fixture for negative tests.

steps.name: Implement ingestion validator
steps.description: Validate ingestion requests and return structured errors.

steps.name: Implement specification model builder
steps.description: Build parsed specification model output from accepted input.

steps.name: Implement Knowledge Unit mapper
steps.description: Map parsed specification elements into deterministic Knowledge Units.

steps.name: Implement local Knowledge Unit store
steps.description: Persist and retrieve Knowledge Units locally.

steps.name: Build execution step factory
steps.description: Create execution steps from Knowledge Units.

steps.name: Build dependency graph builder
steps.description: Create dependency edges between execution steps.

steps.name: Build checkpoint planner
steps.description: Create plan checkpoints for validation boundaries.

steps.name: Build execution plan assembler
steps.description: Assemble steps, dependencies, checkpoints, and modes into a plan.

steps.name: Add plan determinism test
steps.description: Prove same Knowledge Units produce same plan.

steps.name: Create mock capability registration fixture
steps.description: Create one active mock capability registration.

steps.name: Implement capability discovery query
steps.description: Query capabilities by id or type.

steps.name: Implement capability error mapping
steps.description: Map capability failures to structured errors.

steps.name: Implement trace event writer
steps.description: Write trace event records for execution actions.

steps.name: Implement rollback and resume path
steps.description: Rollback and resume from checkpoint only.

steps.name: Implement execution control operations
steps.description: Handle start, pause, resume, and stop.

steps.name: Implement guided step execution operation
steps.description: Execute one guided step through the control surface.

steps.name: Implement planning control operations
steps.description: Expose generate, retrieve, validate, and modify plan operations.

steps.name: Implement observability query operations
steps.description: Expose trace, state, and failure query operations.

steps.name: Implement recovery control operations
steps.description: Expose rollback, resume, and branch operations.

steps.name: Add ISL origin metadata to Knowledge Units
steps.description: Preserve ISL origin references in Knowledge Units.

steps.name: Link plan steps to Knowledge Units
steps.description: Add traceable references from execution steps to Knowledge Units.

steps.name: Link outputs to plan steps
steps.description: Attach output references to producing steps.

steps.name: Add bridge-ready metadata handling
steps.description: Round-trip placeholder bridge metadata without runtime restructuring.

steps.name: Produce first implementation evidence bundle
steps.description: Collect manifest, report, traces, and validations into an evidence bundle.
